messages:
meera: opened PR to add Acadia-13B (int8) to the model catalog — includes limits, quick migration notes, and SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4925
oliver: nice. can you paste the perf numbers you used for the limits table and hardware?
kevin: microbench on a100-sxm4 (1x): p50 gen ~40ms @512 tokens (batch=4). sustained throughput ~150 tok/s @batch=8. memory resident ~42GB with Q4 int8. full csv: https://gist.github.com/kevin/acadia-bench
mahmoud: link-check found a broken relative link in migration guide: `../models/acadia` -> 404. switch to `/models/acadia` canonical slug.
docs-bot: Link check failed: /docs/models/acadia -> 404
sam: also add a compatibility note: Acadia-13B-int8 uses KV layout v2; runtimes <3.1 cannot load int8 artifacts and should auto-fallback to Acadia-13B-fp16. explicit table row please.
meera: will add a "Runtime compatibility" row and mention auto-fallback behavior. Suggested wording?
oliver: short: `Runtime < 3.1: int8 blobs not supported (KV v2). Requests will fallback to Acadia-13B-fp16. Upgrade runtime to use int8.`
kevin: in limits table list `max sequence: 8192 (tested), recommended sustained <=4096`. change generic "quantized" -> "int8 (Q4)" in all places.
mahmoud: dropping SDK snippets for PR (copy/paste):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
texts = ["a","b"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="acadia-13b-int8", input=texts, batch_size=8)
print([d.embedding for d in resp.data])
```
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'acadia-13b-int8', input: ['a','b'], batchSize: 8 })
console.log(resp.data.map(d => d.embedding))
```
meera: added snippets, fixed the link to `/models/acadia`, and updated phrasing. tagging @sam @kevin for review.
docs-bot: PR updated — running checks (link-check, lint)
deploy-bot: docs build passed. staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/models/acadia
sam: LGTM, will approve in the morning :thumbsup
meera: thanks — merging after sam approves, will post a short note in #release-war-room once live.
